findings.evidence: Confirmed at `B/Model.lean:9` and `B/Datum.lean:12`; `Datum.lean:339-347` already provides root, coroot, and pairing restatements, while `Model.lean` provides corresponding operational lemmas such as `rootOfPair_self`, `index_shift`, and `wt_reflMap`.
findings.fix: Remove the global `@[expose]`; expose only any definition whose computation is genuinely required, keep proof-only helpers private where possible, and state definitional API lemmas with `:= (rfl)`/explicit proofs so consumers use the lemmas instead of unfolding.
findings.issue: `@[expose] public section` exposes all definition bodies in both new modules, including `typeBSimplyConnectedRootDatum`, enumeration machinery, and proof helpers, making downstream proofs depend on implementation details.

summary: Both modules globally expose every definition body, including the root datum and numerous implementation-only constructions. The supplied characteristic lemmas make this exposure unnecessary.
